task.question: What are the dates for the 2026 FIFA World Cup co-hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico?
task.evidence: 11 June–19 July: 2026 FIFA World Cup (co-host United States/ Canada/ Mexico)

answer:
I'll search for the dates of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="web_search">
<parameter name="query">2026 FIFA World Cup dates United States Canada Mexico</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="page_find">
<parameter name="page_title">2026 FIFA World Cup</parameter>
<parameter name="question">What are the dates for the 2026 FIFA World Cup?</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

FINAL: The 2026 FIFA World Cup will take place from June 12 to July 12, 2026.
